```{r}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)
```

# Corriger données d'identité

```{r}

rcd_prenom <- function(df, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across({{vars}}, ~ str_to_upper(.x)),
      across({{vars}}, ~ replace_when(.x, .x == "NA" ~ "NAA"))
      )
}

```


```{r}

vars_prenom <- E4_A0 %>% 
  select(sf_enf_prenom, sf_enf_conjt_prenom) %>% 
  colnames()

# Ajouter id_doublon
E4_A1 <- E4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  rcd_prenom(all_of(vars_prenom))

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

E4_A2 <- E4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(E4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:fa_enfants_cat), -enfants_type)

rm(vars_prenom)

```

# Garder les colonnes du module

```{r}

E4_B0 <- E4_A2 %>% 
  relocate(
    c("id_date_nais", "id_sexe", "enfants_date_creation", "enfants_sf_enfants", "sf_enfants",
      "sf_enf_conjt_prenom", "sf_enf_prenom", "sf_enf_sexe", "sf_enf_mois_nais",
      "sf_enf_an_nais", "sf_enf_issu", "sf_enf_mois_adopte", "sf_enf_an_adopte",
      "sf_enf_diag_avt", "sf_enf_muco", "sf_enf_decede", "sf_enf_mois_deces",
      "sf_enf_an_deces", "commentaires_fam"), 
    .after = id_keep) %>% 
  select(-(id_date_creation:etat_mat))

```
